name: Haus Zwischenbrugger
beschreibung: The Haus Zwischenbrugger welcomes holidaymakers to the sunny, peaceful hamlet of Blaiken in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, nestled right at the base of the dramatic Kaisergebirge cliffs. Decorated in a warm Tyrolean cottage style, the guest rooms include contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing unobstructed views of the Wilder Kaiser. Each morning, a nutritious breakfast buffet loaded with local regional specialities prepares visitors for outdoor adventures. The base station of the Brandstadlbahn gondola, providing effortless entry into the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental, is only a short walk away. In summer, the emerald Lake Hintersteiner See and the KaiserWelt Brandstadl adventure park delight guests.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine guesthouse in Blaiken in Scheffau at the Wilder Kaiser with traditional rooms and close to the Brandstadlbahn.
